title: Mentions and send notices float over the composer
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeGmail, open a conversation and press r
Type a line, then @ and the first letters of a synthetic contact
Press Escape; then turn Wi-Fi off, press Cmd+Return and wait for the send error
expected: The contact list floats under the body without moving the signature or the Send bar. The send error floats just above the Send bar with Send again and an x; neither the text nor the bar moves when it appears or is dismissed.
